mcqs.q: Where in Madhya Pradesh were African Cheetahs reintroduced to India in September 2022 under Project Cheetah?
mcqs.exp: Kuno National Park in Sheopur district was chosen as the premier sanctuary for cheetah reintroduction in India.

mcqs.q: Which district of Madhya Pradesh is home to India's only active diamond producing mines?
mcqs.exp: The Majhgawan mine in Panna is operated by NMDC and is the only mechanized diamond mine in India.

subtopics.name: Geography
subtopics.summary: Location, borders, physical terrain, and major river systems of Madhya Pradesh.

facts.title: Capital & Geographic Scope
facts.content: The capital is Bhopal. Madhya Pradesh covers a geographic area of 308,252 sq km across 55 administrative districts.

facts.title: Major Rivers & Drainage Systems
facts.content: Key river systems flowing through the region include: Narmada (Lifeline of MP), Chambal, Betwa, Son, Tapti, Shipra (Ujjain Simhastha Kumbh).

facts.title: Geographical Landscape & Highlights
facts.content: Known as the 'Heart of India' and 'Tiger State of India' (785 tigers). Home to 3 UNESCO World Heritage Sites: Khajuraho temples, Sanchi Stupa, and Bhimbetka Rock Shelters.

subtopics.name: History & Culture
subtopics.summary: Historical formation, classical/folk dances, and vibrant festivals of Madhya Pradesh.

facts.title: State Formation & Language
facts.content: Madhya Pradesh was formally instituted on 1 November 1956. Official language(s): Hindi.

facts.title: Dance Forms & Traditional Arts
facts.content: Celebrated traditional and folk dance forms: Matki, Maanch, Jawara, Grida, Karma.

facts.title: Major Festivals & Celebrations
facts.content: Prominent cultural festivals: Khajuraho Dance Festival, Tansen Samaroh (Gwalior), Lokrang.

subtopics.name: Government & Polity
subtopics.summary: Constitutional leadership, administrative structure, and state symbols of Madhya Pradesh.

facts.title: Governor & Constitutional Head
facts.content: The current Governor is Mangubhai C. Patel.

facts.title: Chief Minister & Administration
facts.content: The Chief Minister of Madhya Pradesh is Mohan Yadav.

facts.title: High Court Jurisdiction
facts.content: Judicial jurisdiction falls under Madhya Pradesh High Court (Jabalpur).

facts.title: Official State Symbols
facts.content: State Animal: Barasingha (Swamp deer) | State Bird: Indian paradise flycatcher (Dhudhraj) | State Flower: White lily | State Tree: Banyan.

subtopics.name: Economy & Agriculture
subtopics.summary: Natural resources, minerals, industrial clusters, and agriculture in Madhya Pradesh.

facts.title: Mineral Wealth & Natural Resources
facts.content: Principal minerals and resources: Diamond (Panna - only active diamond mine in India), Copper (Malanjkhand), Manganese (Balaghat).

facts.title: Economic Profile & Industries
facts.content: Madhya Pradesh plays a vital role in India's economy through key agricultural production, manufacturing corridors, and services.

subtopics.name: Places, Monuments & Tourism
subtopics.summary: Heritage landmarks, national parks, and tourism attractions in Madhya Pradesh.

facts.title: Historic Monuments & Cultural Sites
facts.content: Prominent monuments and heritage landmarks: Khajuraho Group of Monuments (UNESCO), Sanchi Stupa (UNESCO), Bhimbetka Caves (UNESCO), Gwalior Fort, Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga (Ujjain).

facts.title: National Parks & Protected Areas
facts.content: Key protected conservation areas: Kuno (Cheetah reintroduction), Kanha, Bandhavgarh, Panna, Pench, Satpura.

subtopics.name: State Schemes & Awards
subtopics.summary: Prominent welfare schemes, civic initiatives, and state honors of Madhya Pradesh.

facts.title: Key State Welfare Schemes
facts.content: Notable welfare initiatives and government programs: Ladli Behna Yojana, Ladli Laxmi Yojana, Mukhyamantri Seekho Kamao Yojana.
